title: Diagonal evaluation
statement: Let $V$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\ell\in\mathbb N$, $P$ a finite group and $c:Y\to V$ a finite etale $\operatorname{ULift}(P)$-torsor [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Write $E_c$ for its equivariant locally constant section presheaf functor [def-weil-pbc-torsor-associated-module], and $S$ for restriction of scalars along $\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbb Z/\ell)\to\mathbb Z/\ell$. The precomposition of $S E_c$ with the etale localization $Y_{et}\to V_{et}$ is naturally isomorphic to the underlying presheaf functor of the constant module sheaf functor on $Y$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] applied to scalar-restricted underlying representations. The maps are evaluation on the diagonal and equivariant extension.

proof.text: Use objectwise graph evaluation and its bijectivity to make a linear isomorphism after restriction of scalars, by LinearEquiv.ofBijective and toModuleIso.

Naturality in etale objects follows from the equality of scheme morphisms d_W followed by section restriction and the etale morphism followed by d_Wprime. Check this equality by pullback.hom_ext. Naturality in representations is pointwise postcomposition. NatIso.ofComponents therefore assembles these linear isomorphisms into a natural presheaf isomorphism.
Whisker the natural locally-constant/constant-module-sheaf comparison by the scalar-restricted underlying representation functor and compose with the evaluation isomorphism.
